StarlightLater || StarlightLaterAt night, pulses and running use a fifth less charge.How to learn itVega, a robot asleep in Observatory Hill, teaches this when it wakes. Find the way into Observatory Hill first.

ETalk to Tide
…the tide? Is it in? / Bring me 5 of any one thing, like Scrap or Seeds, and talk to me again.

Tide, keeper of Saltwind Beach. I kept the Sea Lock. / We held the sea out and pumped the sweet water inland. The beach grew wide, and quiet. / The sea always brings things back. The piles you dig will fill up again sooner than you think. / The lock's hinges are gone. 10 Copper, please. Try the street with the tall mast.
